output.reason: The linked PR [ev-e643b550bbe9] names what changed: two new opt-in settings, `cache_series_results` and `cache_label_results`, both defaulting to false. Their cache backends are set in new `series_results_cache` and `label_results_cache` blocks under `query_range`, and caching happens after query splitting. [ev-92d2513edb34] adds that the split interval for metadata queries was fixed at 24h and can now be set with a new `split_metadata_queries_by_interval` option. Because the caching is off by default, only operators who turn these settings on are exposed, and an environment that does nothing sees no change, so the consequence can be written as informational. The changelog line [ev-af3b569bbd49] alone is vague, but together with the PR the subject, change, applicability and consequence can all be written as typed assertions.
